hero_concept.title: Ketrik Shell: The Code-First & Agentic-First Operational Hub
hero_concept.subtext: Operational views in Ketrik are declared as structured, serializable layout data. This architecture gives developers full programmatic control to script, version, and orchestrate views in code, while enabling autonomous agents to generate layouts from natural language, detect anomalies, and dynamically adapt UI surfaces during live operations.

sandbox_status.title: Interactive Layout Sandbox
sandbox_status.description: Write JSON schemas, enter prompt instructions, and render live UI widgets inside the canvas buffer in real time.

simulator_metrics.title: Real-Time Event & Telemetry Simulator
simulator_metrics.description: Dial synthetic event throughput and inject operational chaos into the stream.

workflow_agent.title: Workflow Agent
workflow_agent.capability: Listens to telemetry triggers and auto-dispatches backend actions or state updates.

voice_agent.title: Voice & Speech Agent
voice_agent.capability: Hands-free operator control: "Ketrik, isolate Europe stream and expand latency chart."

observer_agent.title: Telemetry Observer Agent
observer_agent.capability: Continuously computes variance and flags threshold breaches on live charts.

triage_agent.title: Incident Triage Agent
triage_agent.role: Dynamic layout mutator during critical events
triage_agent.capability: Generates and injects temporary diagnostic tables and approval buttons when alerts fire.

fin_risk_blueprint.description: Candlestick charts, order-book depth gauges, exposure limits, and automated circuit-breaker action nodes.
